items.title: 1.16 Usability aur security ki saude-bazi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of usability and security trade-offs (PDF 21).

blocks.text: Usability ka matlab hai system use karna kitna asan hai. Qabil-e-istemal system saada aur wazeh hota hai: users use jaldi seekhte aur be-uljhan kaam kar sakte hain, jis se waqt aur mehnat bachti aur user ka itminan barhta hai.

Security ka matlab systems aur data ki hifazat hai. Yeh be-ijazat rasai rokti, viruses aur hackers se bachati, maloomat ko raaz aur mehfooz rakhti, aur nuqsan ka khatra kam karti hai. Har system ko bunyadi security chahiye.
Usability aur security ke darmiyan saude-bazi

items: Security barhana system ko use karne mein mushkil bana sakta hai.
Mazboot passwords yaad rakhna mushkil hai.
Login ke izafi qadam users ko sust karte hain.
Saada systems use mein asan magar kam mehfooz hain, aur security hatana khatra barhata hai.

blocks.text: Mehfooz aur asan istemal ke liye tawazun zaroori hai. Maslan password manager ya fingerprint login mazboot security barqarar rakhte hue user ke liye asani paida kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik misal dein jahan izafi security system ko use karna mushkil banati hai, aur us mushkil ko kam karne ka aik tareeqa.
blocks.explanation: Misal: bank app jo har dafa password aur one-time code mangti hai, kholne mein zyada waqt leti hai. Fingerprint ya chehre se login, ya bharosemand device yaad rakhna, kam qadmon mein use mehfooz rakhta hai.

items: Usability: seekhne aur use mein asan; security: be-ijazat rasai aur hamlon se hifazat.
Zyada security aksar kam suhulat; tawazun zaroori.
